items.prompt: I decided to take part ______ the club’s weekly show when the school year began.

items.prompt: At first I was too nervous ______ speak into the microphone.

items.prompt: We shared the work: I was responsible ______ recording the interviews, and Anya was in charge of editing them.

title: The Train to Seabury

items.prompt: The train didn't go all the way to Seabury, so we had to ______ trains at Westford.
items.explanation: 前一班车无法直达，change trains 表示换乘。

items.prompt: We still managed to ______ at Seabury before lunch.
items.explanation: arrive at 表示到达某个地点或车站。

items.prompt: When we stepped onto the ______, our aunt was there to meet us.
items.explanation: 下火车后踩到的是车站的站台。

items.prompt: It had been a long ______, so we went straight to her house to rest.
items.explanation: journey 指从出发地到目的地的这段旅程。

items.prompt: The cycle path is open ______ seven in the morning to seven in the evening.
items.explanation: from A to B 表示从某个时间持续到另一个时间。

items.prompt: Some of my friends went to the coast ______ train.

items.explanation: it does 代替 it rains。if 表示假设；when、whenever 和 once 表示下雨时可以换乘。

items.prompt: I kept my map ______ my pocket, so I could take it out whenever I needed it.

items.explanation: until、till 或 from ... to 都可以表示停留从阵雨开始持续到雨停。

title: A Pond in the Park

items.prompt: On my next visit, I began to ______ small movements in the water.

items.explanation: there are 用于说明某处有两个箱子。

items.prompt: Since April, several bees ______ made nests in them, and more are arriving this week.
